statusLine.command: b=$(bash ~/.claude/ponytail-statusline.sh); ctx=$(jq -r '.context_window | (.current_usage // {}) as $u | (($u.input_tokens // 0) + ($u.cache_creation_input_tokens // 0) + ($u.cache_read_input_tokens // 0)) as $t | "ctx \($t/1000|floor)k/\(.context_window_size/1000|floor)k (\(.used_percentage // 0 | floor)%)"'); echo "${b:+$b }$ctx"
